chemistry-m1-c.thinking.0: Graham's Law and Gas Diffusion Rate Comparison
chemistry-m1-c.s.s1.prompt: [Advanced Diffusion Rate] Cotton soaked in concentrated ammonia water (molecular mass 17) and cotton soaked in concentrated hydrochloric acid (molecular mass 36.5) were placed at the same time at the two ends of a long glass tube and the ends were plugged with rubber stoppers. chemistry-m1-c.s.s1.explain: The diffusion rate of a gas is inversely proportional to the square root of its molecular mass. chemistry-killer-07.material: At standard temperature and pressure (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol of gas = 22.4 L), a gas mixture of methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) and carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) has a volume of 11.2 L and a mass of 16.4 g. Atomic masses are H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, and Avogadro's number is $N_A$. How many atoms in total are in this mixture?
chemistry-killer-07.thinking.0: Three States of Matter and Molecular Models
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: At standard temperature and pressure (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol of gas = 22.4 L), a gas mixture of methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) and carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) has a volume of 11.2 L and a mass of 16.4 g. Atomic masses are H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, and Avogadro's number is $N_A$. How many atoms in total are in this mixture?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Step 1: Total moles = 11.2 L / 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol, so x + y = 0.5.
Step 2: Mass: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Substitute y = 0.5 - x: 16x + 22 - 44x = 16.4, so 28x = 5.6, x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Step 3: Atoms: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ has 5 atoms per molecule, 0.2 x 5 = 1.0 mol; $\mathrm{CO_2}$ has 3, 0.3 x 3 = 0.9 mol. Total 1.9 mol of atoms = $1.9\,N_A$.
Answer: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Wrong options: 1.5 assumes all CO2, 2.5 assumes all CH4, 1.7 counts only 4 atoms for CH4.)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
